name: Check Transaction: Both Deposit and Withdrawal Hit
description: CAP-06 LookupOrder: Verify check-transaction prioritizes deposit record when both tables have matching trade_no (BR-26)

queries.name: deposit_record
queries.sql: SELECT no, trade_no, user_id, amount, status FROM deposit_records WHERE trade_no = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL

queries.name: withdrawal_record
queries.sql: SELECT no, trade_no, user_id, amount, status FROM withdrawal_records WHERE trade_no = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
